verdict.rationale: Conta Simples' own API lets you retrieve card and bank statements, download receipts and linked invoice files, and list categories, cost centers, suppliers, users, cards and bills, so much of an account's data can be pulled out programmatically. There is no documented one-click or bulk export, no named open formats (CSV/OFX/JSON dumps), and nothing on account closure or leaving. missing for 10: a documented full-account export feature, explicit open-format outputs, coverage of all data types, an offboarding/account-closure path, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
